battle.name: 竇建德起義
battle.brief: 大業七年冬，隋煬帝再征高句麗，河北饑荒流散，漳州農民竇建德聚眾數百，旋以劫糧為名聚至數萬，據清河、樂壽，與隋將張須陀相持十年，成為北方最大義軍。卡面亞述長弓是西亞反曲複合弓的祖型，義軍陣上並無此弓，真正左右戰局者乃隋軍強弩、長矛方陣與義和騎兵。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 大業七年的河北，實際上是三股力量互相擠壓的地帶。朝廷一方是隋朝：隋煬帝把足以決戰的精兵與大批糧秣一齊調往遼東攻打高句麗，留守河北的只剩各州縣的殘存府兵、鄉兵與臨時召集的團練，河北道行軍總管張須陀是其中最出色的指揮官，所部以漢軍為主，配制式弓弩、鎧冑與長矛；張須陀死後，樊子蓋、宇文化及等相繼接任，靠據城守險維持對河北各州郡的點狀控制。義軍一方是竇建德在漳州拉起來的隊伍，起初不過鄉里數百人，靠劫掠官倉、吸收流民迅速膨脹，主體是河北農民，隨即又吞併了高士達、王仁則、高孝德等河北各股義軍的部眾；義軍騎兵比例偏低，卻靠繳獲的隋軍甲馬、驅趕的民夫與在地方上建立起來的徵發網維持戰力，兵員、糧食與作戰區域高度重疊。第三方是北方新起的唐：武德年間李淵在太原建國，最初與竇建德遣使往來，藉此牽制隋與王世充，待河北與中原的爭奪明朗，唐軍便親自下河北。第三方在場，使河北衝突不再是單純的亂民與朝廷之爭，而成為群雄爭奪地盤的一環，河北的糧食、馬匹與人口也因此同時被三方覬覦。義軍與唐的關係最為微妙：先是互通款曲、並肩對隋，隨即在河北與洛陽兩線上短兵相接，終以虎牢關一役分曉歸屬。
countriesEn: The Hebei plain in 611 was a zone in which three forces pressed against one another. On the side of the court was the Sui dynasty: Emperor Yang had carried off to Liaodong to campaign against Goguryeo the troops that could actually decide a battle, together with a great part of the state's grain, and what remained in Hebei was little more than the depleted mingguan and xiangbing of the prefectures, plus locally raised militia. The most accomplished commander among them was Zhang Xutuo, appointed Grand Commander of the Hebei circuit; his force was Chinese in the main, equipped with regulation crossbows, bows, armour and long spears. After his death Fan Zigan and Yuwen Huaji took over in turn, holding the prefectures of Hebei as a scatter of isolated points of control. On the side of the insurgents was the force Dou Jiande raised at Zhangzhou, which began with a few hundred men from his own village and swelled rapidly by raiding government granaries and absorbing refugees, its body composed chiefly of the peasants of Hebei; it then swallowed up the bands of Gao Shida, Wang Renze and Gao Xiaode, other rebel leaders in the province. The proportion of cavalry in the rebel army was low, and its strength rested on warhorses and armour taken from Sui troops, on the labour it could compel, and on a system of local levy and requisition built up in the districts; men, grain and area of operations overlapped almost exactly. The third party was the newly risen Tang in the north: in the Wude era Li Yuan established his state at Taiyuan and at first exchanged envoys with Dou Jiande, so as to pin Sui and Wang Shichong from two sides; once the contest over Hebei and the Central Plain became open, the Tang army came down into Hebei itself. With that third party in the field, the conflict in Hebei was no longer a plain quarrel between rabble and court but one round of the struggle among warlords for territory, and the grain, horses and population of Hebei were accordingly coveted by all three at once. The most delicate relationship was that between the insurgents and the Tang: first cordiality and a common cause against Sui, then short sharp war on the Hebei and Luoyang fronts, and finally a single decision at Hulao Pass as to who would own the province.
people: 竇建德（生年不詳—621）是河北漳州人，出身農家，《舊唐書》記其被擒時年六十二；年輕時在郡中任事，中年後遇上連年天災與兵役，於大業七年冬在鄉里起兵，靠劫糧聚眾，自稱夏王，最後稱帝建夏、定都樂壽，成為隋末北方規模最大、延續最久的農民政權。高士達是義軍中最早成名的悍將，本為河北另一支起義軍的首領，率眾歸附竇建德後仍獨當一面，大業九年與張須陀戰於河間，中伏被斬，義軍元氣大傷，此役也迫使竇建德改變與隋軍硬碰的作風。隋將張須陀（生年不詳—614）是河南郡人，出身寒微而驍勇善戰，治軍以賞罰分明、兵精自負，屢次以少量精兵擊破義軍龐大雜眾，率步兵持長矛成陣而前、以騎兵反擊密集放箭之敵，屢建戰功，最終戰歿於清河，隋朝在河北的戰爭骨幹由此崩解。凌敬是竇建德的重要參謀，河北大定後力主先取河北以為根本、再圖天下，勸他在唐軍逼近時放棄救援洛陽、斷然回軍攻取河北，此策未被採納，成為虎牢關敗亡的伏筆。李世民是唐軍主帥，武德四年正月率軍出井陘、徑趨河北，在洺水與虎牢關一帶兩度擊破義軍，五月將竇建德追擒於牛口渚；竇建德被押送長安後授將軍，貞觀十八年因謀反被處死。李淵、王世充、宇文化及分據太原、洛陽與魏郡一帶，構成義軍腹背受敵的外部環境；隋煬帝則在江都遇弒，隋室的崩解與唐的接管自此步步相隨。
peopleEn: Dou Jiande (date of birth unknown - 621) was a man of Zhangzhou in Hebei, born into a farming family; the Jiutangshu records that he was sixty-two years old when he was taken. After serving in office in his commandery in his youth, he met years of natural disaster and military service, and in the winter of the seventh year of the Daye era he raised a revolt in his home village, gathering a crowd by seizing grain, styling himself Prince of Xia, and finally proclaiming himself emperor, founding the state of Xia with its capital at Leshou. He thus became the largest and longest-lived peasant regime in northern China in the closing years of Sui. Gao Shida was the most famous of his lieutenants, originally the leader of another rising in Hebei who brought his band over to Dou Jiande and continued to command an independent wing; in the ninth year of Daye he was intercepted by Zhang Xutuo at Hejian and cut down, and the insurgents suffered a blow from which they never fully recovered, and the defeat also forced Dou to abandon the habit of meeting the Sui army head-on in open battle. The Sui general Zhang Xutuo (date of birth unknown - 614), a man of Henanzi who rose from humble origins, was brave and skilled in war, and prided himself on strict rewards and punishments and on the quality of his troops; repeatedly he broke much larger and more heterogeneous rebel crowds with a handful of picked soldiers, ordering his foot to advance in a phalanx of long spears and his horse to counter-charge the enemy who shot in dense volleys, and he won battle after battle before dying in the fighting at Qinghe, which shattered the backbone of Sui's war in Hebei. Ling Jing was Dou Jiande's chief adviser; after Hebei had been settled in his favour he urged him to seize Hebei first as a base and then aspire to the whole realm, and to abandon the relief of Luoyang when Tang troops closed in, turning back at once to take Hebei. The advice was not taken, and it was the premonition of the ruin at Hulao. Li Shimin commanded the Tang army: in the first month of the fourth year of Wude he led troops out of Jingxing straight into Hebei, twice breaking the insurgents at the Mingshui and around Hulao, and in the fifth month he pursued Dou Jiande down to the Niukou shoal and took him prisoner. Dou was escorted to the capital and made a general, and was executed for plotting rebellion in the eighteenth year of Zhenguan. Li Yuan, Wang Shichong and Yuwen Huaji held Taiyuan, Luoyang and Wei commanderies respectively, forming the external situation in which the insurgents were pressed from front and rear; Emperor Yang of Sui was meanwhile killed at Jiangdu, and the collapse of Sui and the takeover by Tang followed step by step from that point.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓，是西亞最早成型的反曲複合弓代表：弓體以木為芯，角、筋與皮分層黏合，張力大而形制小，亞述人靠弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域，弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。它不會出現在大業七年的河北——這件兵器屬於公元前七百年的兩河，與竇建德的起義相隔一千三百年。但它並非與這場戰爭無關：亞述弓所代表的，正是自東向西傳播的那一套複合反曲弓技術譜系，戰國以後的中國已發展出以角為背、以筋為心的角弓與反曲弓，漢代邊軍的弓弩、隋軍的步弩與義軍繳獲的舊弩，都屬於同一技術家族的下游；換言之，亞述長弓是這場戰爭中「弓」這個兵種的祖型標本，而不是實物。真正在場的裝備如下：隋軍以制式步弩、弓矢、長矛與鎧冑為主，張須陀部尤重長矛，步兵持矛成列抵禦敵騎反覆衝撞，騎兵著散裝甲胄、操刀槊，攻城時用雲梯、撞車與穴地攻城具，並依永濟渠與河北官道轉運糧秣；義軍初期多以農具改造成兵，削尖的木桿、扁擔、耒耜與投擲用的標槍即是長兵，弓則為鄉民自備的獵弓，數量有限，近距離搏鬥全靠白刃；馬匹是義軍最缺的資源，河北良馬多被隋軍與各地方武裝扣留，義軍的騎兵多靠繳獲與地方徵發，導致騎步比例長期偏低，行軍、追擊與護糧都因此吃力。虎牢關之役，竇建德以十餘萬眾與唐軍相持，卻以步兵與雜兵為主，弓弩覆蓋不足，與李世民的精騎相撞時缺乏縱深與遮蔽；而唐軍的甲騎、馬槊與長槍，仍是隋唐軍制在河北的延續。武器之外，糧食與車馬同樣是裝備的一部分：河北是隋朝最大的糧倉之一，竇建德遠征洛陽時曾大批運糧濟助王世充，這條糧道後來成了唐軍覬覦河北的真正理由。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on this card is the earliest type of recurve composite bow to be developed in Western Asia: a wooden core faced with horn, sinew and hide in layers, giving high tension from a small frame, and it was the combination of bow and iron that carried the Assyrians through the Mesopotamian river valleys, with archers shooting from the chariot and the charioteers following the archers in. It would not be found in Hebei in the seventh year of Daye - the weapon belongs to the two rivers of the seventh century before the Common Era, some thirteen hundred years before Dou Jiande's rising. Nor is it unrelated to the war: what the Assyrian bow stands for is the composite recurve tradition that spread from the east across Asia, and China after the Warring States period had already developed the horn-backed, sinew-bellied horn bow and recurve bow; the bows and crossbows of the Han frontier armies, the foot crossbows of the Sui and the old crossbows the insurgents took as booty all belong to the downstream end of that same technical family. The Assyrian bow, in other words, is the archetype of the missile arm as it appears in this war rather than an object that fought in it. The equipment actually present was as follows. The Sui army was built on regulation foot crossbows, bows and arrows, long spears and body armour; Zhang Xutuo's troops put special weight on the spear, with infantry standing in ranks of pikes against repeated cavalry charges, and horse archers and lancers wearing partial armour; siege work used scaling ladders, battering rams and earth-working machines, and grain was moved along the Yongji Canal and the roads of Hebei. The insurgents at first turned farm tools into weapons - sharpened poles, carrying yokes, ploughshares and javelins for throwing - and their bows were the hunting bows carried by the villagers, few in number, with close combat settled by the edge of the blade. Horses were the resource they lacked most: the good horses of Hebei were largely held by the Sui army and by local armed bands, so the rebel cavalry was recruited from booty and local levy, which kept the ratio of horse to foot low and made marching, pursuit and the protection of the supply line all the harder. At Hulao, Dou Jiande brought more than a hundred thousand men to stand against the Tang, but they were infantry and irregulars in the main, thinly covered by bow and crossbow, and when they met Li Shimin's picked horse they had neither depth nor cover. The Tang armour, horse-lances and long pikes were themselves the continuation in Hebei of the Sui and Tang military system. Beyond weapons, grain and draught animals were part of the equipment: Hebei was among the largest granaries of the Sui, and when Dou marched on Luoyang he carried large quantities of grain to aid Wang Shichong, and that supply road later became the real reason the Tang army coveted Hebei.
tactics: 起義初期，竇建德的打法是典型的流民式游擊：以鄉里為根據，避開城池與大道，專打郡縣的倉庫、驛站與徵發點，把糧食布帛變成兵員與馬匹，再退入鄉野待機；這套不據城、不戍守的作風讓隋軍的據點與糧道持續受壓，卻也令義軍缺乏可守之城與可算的賦役。大業九年張須陀在河間與高士達交鋒時，展示了隋軍對付雜眾的標準套路：先以少量騎兵反覆挑釁，誘使密集的義軍放箭還擊，等到對方矢石疲憊、前排人馬擠壓成一團，再以步兵持長矛、列陣而前，一鼓穿透敵陣，騎兵隨即由兩翼掩殺反覆突入，直至義軍崩散；義軍的問題正在於人數雖眾而甲兵不精，弓矢一旦耗盡，密集隊形就變成長桿與刀矛的犧牲場。義軍自身也逐步學會用騎兵：竇建德在河北建立起名為義和的武裝，以河北子弟為主、自備馬匹兵甲，作為主力突擊力量，但仍以步兵結陣、依村堡與土壘固守。隋廷的對策則是把鎮壓河北的兵權集中於河北道行軍總管，徵發各州鄉兵、以城為點、逐步收復失陷州縣，並靠運河與官道維持遠距離調動。兵分兩線的戰略最終要了河北的命：武德四年正月，李世民率精兵出井陘直入河北，先在洺水一線擊破竇建德前軍，竇軍退保；四月李世民進據虎牢關，以險地卡住洛陽通道，派宇文士及率精騎出關挑戰、日夜騷擾，專門消耗竇軍的弓箭與體力，待其矢盡人疲，再令李世勣夜襲其營，而李世民本人率驍騎繞出虎牢關、從側後插入，竇軍中軍自相踐踏，騎兵一路追至牛口渚，竇建德被擒。此役的關鍵不在人數，而在三件事：關隘的據守、箭矢的存量、以及不被牽制、不被勸返的決斷。
tacticsEn: In its opening phase Dou Jiande's movement fought in the classic fashion of a refugee host: it based itself on the villages, avoided the walled cities and the main roads, and struck at the granaries, courier stations and levy posts of the commanderies, converting grain and cloth into men and horses before withdrawing into the countryside to wait. This way of fighting without holding cities and without garrisoning them kept the Sui depots and supply lines under constant pressure, but it also left the insurgents without defensible walls and without a regular revenue. When Zhang Xutuo met Gao Shida at Hejian in the ninth year of Daye, he showed the standard Sui method for breaking a heterogeneous crowd: a small body of horse first rode up again and again to provoke, tempting the packed insurgents into volley after volley of arrows; once the enemy arrows were spent and the front ranks of the host were crushed together into a single mass, the foot advanced in a phalanx of long spears and broke through in one push, and the horse charged in behind from both flanks, cutting into the crowd again and again until it broke apart. The insurgents' real handicap was numbers without armoured discipline: once their arrows ran out, the dense formation became a target for long poles and blades. The insurgents also learned to use cavalry: Dou built up in Hebei an armed body known as the Yihe, made up of Hebei sons with their own horses and arms, used as the striking force, though they still fought in infantry lines and sheltered behind village strongholds and earthen works. The court's answer was to concentrate the task of pacifying Hebei in a single Grand Commander of the Hebei circuit, to levy the militia of every prefecture, to hold the towns as points and to recover lost prefectures one by one, and to keep long-range movement alive by the canal and the roads. It was the strategy of fighting on two fronts that destroyed Hebei in the end. In the first month of the fourth year of Wude, Li Shimin took picked troops out of Jingxing straight into Hebei and broke Dou's leading army on the Mingshui, and Dou fell back to cover himself; in the fourth month Li Shimin occupied Hulao Pass, using the ground to close the road to Luoyang, and sent Yuwen Shiji out of the pass with picked horse to skirmish day and night, deliberately wearing down the insurgents' arrows and their stamina; when their arrows were spent and their men exhausted, Li Shiji was ordered to raid their camp by night, while Li Shimin himself took his fastest horse round the pass and struck in from the flank and rear, the rebel centre collapsed into itself, and the cavalry pursued them to the Niukou shoal, where Dou Jiande was taken. The turning point of this battle lay not in numbers but in three things: the holding of the pass, the store of arrows, and the resolution not to be pinned down and not to be talked out of the plan.
data: 大業七年（611）起兵時，竇建德手中的武力不過鄉里數百人，兩三年之間聚眾至數萬，攻取樂壽、聊城等河北州郡；到隋煬帝崩潰前後，其眾號稱數十萬，控制的城池以十數計，政權最初僅稱夏王，618年稱帝後改元明月、定都樂壽，佔地大致相當於今河北南部與山東北部的一部分。與義軍膨脹同時，隋朝把主力投向高句麗：大業八年大舉征高句麗，兵員達一百一十三萬人，士卒死亡者十之八九，歸國者不過二三千，這一削直接把隋朝能用的精騎與國家積蓄耗在遼東，留給河北的只有二流兵與地方團練。雙方在兵員上的對比極為懸殊：大業九年河間之戰，竇建德與高士達合兵十餘萬，張須陀所部不過數千精騎，卻一戰斬高士達、破其眾；虎牢關之役，竇建德率十餘萬眾自河北南下，聲援洛陽，唐軍出動的精騎約三千五百，李世民以之掩護步兵衝陣，竇軍大潰，竇建德被擒，追兵至牛口渚，河北州縣望風歸順，隨軍被擄的河北官員與將士數百人被解送長安。起義自611年算起歷時十年，橫跨隋煬帝與唐高祖兩朝，最終以虎牢關一戰收束。距離上，河北重鎮樂壽至洛陽約數百里，一往一返多在旬日之內，義軍每一次離開河北都意味著拉長數百里糧道，也正因如此，竇建德每一次離開河北都成了致命的失誤。
dataEn: When Dou Jiande rose in the seventh year of Daye (611) the force in his hands was no more than a few hundred village men; within two or three years it had swollen to tens of thousands and had taken such Hebei prefectures and commanderies as Leshou and Liaocheng. By the time Emperor Yang of Sui was collapsing, his following was reckoned at several hundred thousand, the number of walled towns he held was counted in tens, and the regime bore the title of Prince of Xia until he proclaimed himself emperor in 618, changed the era to Mingyue and fixed his capital at Leshou; the territory covered roughly the southern part of modern Hebei and the northern part of modern Shandong. At the same time as the insurgents swelled, the Sui threw its main strength against Goguryeo: in the eighth year of Daye it mustered 1,130,000 men for the great expedition, of whom eight or nine in ten died and only two or three thousand came home, and that single blow spent the Sui's usable picked horse and its national reserves in Liaodong, leaving nothing but second-rate troops and local militia for Hebei. The contrast in numbers was extreme. At the battle of Hejian in the ninth year of Daye, Dou Jiande and Gao Shida brought together more than a hundred thousand men, while Zhang Xutuo commanded only some thousands of picked horse; he cut down Gao Shida and broke the host in one action. At Hulao, Dou Jiande led more than a hundred thousand men south out of Hebei to relieve Luoyang, while the Tang brought into action about three thousand five hundred picked horse, which Li Shimin used to cover his infantry's charge; the rebel army collapsed, Dou Jiande was taken, the pursuit ran to the Niukou shoal, and the prefectures of Hebei came over to the Tang at the first sight of the banners, several hundred Hebei officials and soldiers being sent under guard to the capital. Counting from 611 the rising ran for ten years, spanning the reigns of Emperor Yang of Sui and Emperor Gaozu of Tang, and it was finally closed out in a single battle at Hulao. In terms of distance, Leshou in Hebei lies some several hundred li from Luoyang, and a march either way was normally counted in tens of days, so that every time the insurgents left Hebei they lengthened a supply road of several hundred li; for that very reason every departure from Hebei by Dou Jiande turned into a fatal error.
cause: 竇建德起義的直接背景，是隋朝在開皇末年以來積累的崩潰壓力。大業年間，隋煬帝連年大舉征高句麗，役使的壯丁以百萬計，河北是丁役與租調的主要出處之一；同時水旱災頻仍，漳水、滄水一帶的河北平原屢遭水患，饑民離鄉，流亡塞道。朝廷的應對卻是加重而不是減輕：為供東征，隋廷在河北括戶、預徵糧草、加派雜役，把大批糧食沿永濟渠與官道運往涿郡一線供應前線，鄉民既失耕地又失口糧。而真正決定性的空隙，是隋朝把能打的那支兵抽走了：精騎重甲多在遼東，河北只剩各州縣的府兵殘部、鄉兵與臨時團練，指揮系統因名將相繼調任而斷續，彈壓力量分散在數十個孤立的州縣據點上。竇建德本人是漳州農民，起事時的目的只是求食：集眾百餘人劫掠郡縣倉廩，奪得米帛分與鄉里；一旦流民發現官府無力保護，數百人便滾成數萬人。於是饑荒是導火索，兵役與糧秣的榨取是燃料，地方武力的空虛才是那個讓火燒得起來的空間；起義一旦越出饑民暴動的範圍，就變成了一場有政治目標的割據運動。
causeEn: The immediate background of Dou Jiande's rising was the pressure that had built up in the Sui since the end of the Kaihuang era. Through the years of Daye, Emperor Yang of Sui launched repeated great campaigns against Goguryeo and put hundreds of thousands of adult men into service, and Hebei was one of the principal sources of both labour and revenue for those campaigns. At the same time floods and droughts were frequent, the Hebei plain around the Zhang and Cang rivers was repeatedly inundated, and the hungry left their homes to crowd the roads. The court's response was to add to the burden rather than lighten it: to feed the eastern armies, the Sui made head counts in Hebei, levied grain in advance and imposed miscellaneous labour, carrying large quantities of provisions along the Yongji Canal and the official roads to the front at Zhu commandery, so that the country people lost both their fields and their food. The truly decisive opening, however, was that the Sui had removed the troops that could fight: the armoured horse and the trained infantry were in Liaodong, and Hebei was left with the depleted mingguan of the prefectures, with militia, and with hastily raised bands, while the chain of command was broken by the transfer of its best commanders elsewhere and the force for repression was scattered over dozens of isolated county posts. Dou Jiande himself was a farmer of Zhangzhou, and the purpose of the rising at the start was simply to get food: a hundred men were collected to plunder the granaries of the commanderies, and the grain and cloth they seized were shared out among the villagers; once the refugees found that the government could no longer protect them, a few hundred men rolled up into tens of thousands. Famine was therefore the fuse, the conscription and the extraction of grain were the fuel, and the emptiness of local armed power was the space in which the fire could take hold; and once the rising passed beyond the stage of a hungry mob, it became a separatist movement with political aims.
impact: 竇建德起義的影響，遠不只在河北一地。第一，它把隋末的亂局從流民暴動推向政權競爭：竇建德建夏、置郡縣、稱帝改元，說明河北的流民武裝已能佔據大片州郡並徵收賦役，這對同一時期的李密、竇建德、劉武周、蕭銇等割據者都是示範，也逼得唐、隋兩方先把河北當作必須解決的戰略問題。第二，它加速了隋朝崩解與唐朝取而代之：河北既已脫離朝廷，隋煬帝的征遼軍隊與河北義軍在戰略上互相牽制，兩線作戰令隋朝疲於奔命；618年隋煬帝在江都遇弒，619年宇文化及在魏郡弒唐國公，建立僅三年的隋朝隨之瓦解，李淵建立的唐朝於是順勢接管河北。第三，它改變了唐初用兵的方向：武德四年唐軍出井陘、下河北，正是趁河北疲於兩線、無力再戰之機，一舉解除背後之患，此後北方得以專心對付劉武周與王世充，直至貞觀初年統一。就裝備與戰術史而言，這場戰爭留下的經驗極為清晰：面對人口眾多而裝備駁雜的流民武裝，隋唐兩方的答案不是靠人數，而是靠精騎、長矛陣與強弩的三件套，加上以堅城險隘控制通道、以糧道控制距離；河北平原上的騎兵較量，最後還是以唐軍的騎兵與決斷收場。竇建德被擒後，他的一批舊部散入河北與山東，或降唐，或轉投竇憲德、劉黑闥，隋末群雄最後一輪較量因此延續到貞觀初年。
impactEn: The effects of Dou Jiande's rising reached far beyond Hebei. First, it pushed the disorder of the late Sui from mob revolt towards competition for power: by founding Xia, establishing commanderies and counties and proclaiming an emperor with a new era, Dou showed that a refugee army in Hebei could seize wide stretches of territory and levy taxes and labour, which served as a demonstration to the other separatists of the time, Li Mi, Dou Jiande, Liu Wuzhou and Xiao Ze, and forced both Sui and Tang to treat Hebei as a strategic problem that had to be solved. Second, it hastened the collapse of Sui and its replacement by Tang: once Hebei had broken away, the Sui expedition against Goguryeo and the Hebei insurgents pulled against each other strategically, and fighting on two fronts wore the dynasty out; Emperor Yang was killed at Jiangdu in 618, Yuwen Huaji murdered the Duke of Tang at Wei commandery in 619, and the Sui, founded only three years earlier, fell apart, so that the state built by Li Yuan took over Hebei by its own momentum. Third, it changed the direction of Tang military planning at the beginning of the dynasty: in the fourth year of Wude the Tang marched out of Jingxing into Hebei, taking advantage of the fact that Hebei was exhausted by two fronts and unable to fight again, and thereby removed the danger from behind; the north was then free to concentrate on Liu Wuzhou and Wang Shichong until the unification of the early Zhenguan years. In terms of the history of equipment and tactics, the lesson of this war is unusually clear: faced with a host of great numbers but ill-assorted arms, the answer of both Sui and Tang was not numbers but a triad of picked horse, spear phalanx and strong crossbow, reinforced by holding fortified passes to control the road and by the supply line to control distance; the contest of horse on the Hebei plain was settled in the end by Tang cavalry and Tang resolve. After Dou Jiande was taken, a part of his old followers scattered into Hebei and Shandong, some submitting to Tang and some joining Dou Xiande or Liu Heita, and the last round of the late-Sui contest was thereby carried on into the early Zhenguan years.
result: 大業七年到武德四年，竇建德用十年間完成了從數百鄉人到一方割據者的全部路程：起兵於漳州，據樂壽、冀州等河北重鎮，控弦之士以十萬計，618年稱帝改元明月、國號夏，618至619年間曾兩度南下救援被王世充圍困的洛陽，又在河北與唐軍反覆爭奪洺水、魏郡一線。結局則由虎牢關一役決定：武德四年五月，李世民率精騎約三千五百追擊至牛口渚，竇軍大潰，竇建德為部下所執送見唐軍，隨即被押送長安，河北諸州縣隨即歸唐，他建立的夏政權在十年間由建都到覆亡，河北重回單一王朝控制之下。竇建德被授將軍，留京閑居數年，至貞觀十八年因與舊部謀反被處死；與此同時他的從孫竇憲德在河北收拾舊部再起，又被李世民於622年擊破，隋末最後一點河北義軍的餘波才真正平定。這場起義的結局同時標誌著唐初北方戰略格局的定型：以精騎決戰、以險隘卡住通道、以軍心與糧道決定遠征成敗的唐軍模式被證明有效，而義軍那種以人數換取地盤、在兩個戰區之間疲於奔命的模式，則隨著竇建德的被擒而告終。惟須留意，關於此役的具體人數與細節，隋唐史籍記載多有誇大與互異之處，數字當以量級觀之，不宜作精確依據。
resultEn: Between the seventh year of Daye and the fourth year of Wude, Dou Jiande completed in ten years the whole distance from a few hundred village men to a ruler of his own region: he rose at Zhangzhou, seized such Hebei strongholds as Leshou and Jizhou, counted by the hundred thousand the men under his command, proclaimed himself emperor in 618 with the era Mingyue and the state of Xia, and between 618 and 619 twice marched south to relieve Luoyang, which Wang Shichong had invested, while contesting the Tang along the Mingshui and Wei lines in Hebei. The outcome was settled by the single action at Hulao: in the fifth month of the fourth year of Wude, Li Shimin pursued with some three thousand five hundred picked horse to the Niukou shoal, the rebel army collapsed, Dou Jiande was taken by his own men and brought before the Tang, and was presently escorted to the capital; the prefectures of Hebei came over to the Tang at once, the Xia state he had built passed from its founding at its capital to its destruction within ten years, and Hebei returned to the control of a single dynasty. Dou Jiande was made a general and kept at the capital for several years, and was executed for plotting with his old followers in the eighteenth year of Zhenguan. Meanwhile his cousin's son Dou Xiande gathered the old bands in Hebei and rose again, and was defeated by Li Shimin in 622; only then was the last of the Hebei insurgents of the late Sui truly put down. The outcome of this rising at the same time marks the fixing of the strategic pattern of the early Tang in the north: the Tang mode of war, which decided battles with picked horse, closed the roads with passes and made the outcome of a long march depend on the state of the army and on the supply road, was proved sound, while the rebel mode of trading men for territory and exhausting itself between two theatres ended with Dou Jiande's capture. It should be noted, however, that the numbers and details of this war are exaggerated and contradictory in the Sui and Tang histories, and that they should be read as orders of magnitude rather than as exact figures.
